title: Ralac's Simple HUD
description: Adds a simple HUD to the actionbar
body:
This datapack adds a simple HUD to the actionbar showing your coordinates as well as the direction of north and the world time.

To set the clock to 12 hour time run `/trigger hud.12hr`
with `/trigger hud.24hr` changing it back to 24 hour time
![A Screenshot showing the custom HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31cd60b068c4332b9bd7aa843eb8e2e746344583.webp)
